title: GOESB Benchmark Profile
description: An official, versioned definition of exactly how a benchmark is run and scored.

id.description: Globally unique, immutable profile id, e.g. 'whisper-medium-nl-batch'.

version.description: Semantic version. A changed scoring rule requires a new version.

context_reset.description: Whether the runtime resets its decoder context/prompt before every utterance ('per_utterance' — the correct choice for a benchmark corpus of independent clips) or lets it carry across calls within a run ('carried'). Its absence used to be ambiguous to a reader — a real, verified false-negative WER moved by tens of points when a downstream reimplementation carried context across a corpus loop; every batch/streaming profile should declare this explicitly rather than leave it implicit in adapter code a reader can't see.

initial_prompt.description: Text prompt prepended before decoding each utterance, if the runtime supports one. Null/absent means no prompt is used.

configuration.description: Fixed decode/streaming knobs required for reproducibility.

streaming_latency_ms.description: Encoder right-attention-context (lookahead) latency for cache-aware streaming engines, e.g. 'nemotron'. Deliberately NOT 'chunk_ms': that is a bounded re-decode window an adapter chooses freely, while this is a fixed algorithmic latency the checkpoint itself declares (transformers exposes it as processor.supported_streaming_latencies_ms) and which also fixes the exact mel-frame count every audio chunk must carry. A profile declares one or the other, never both (ADR-0013 §3).

concurrency.description: Simultaneous transcription requests to run at once (concurrency benchmark_type only).

duration_s.description: Fixed wall-clock measurement window per concurrency level (concurrency benchmark_type only).

normalization.description: Text normalization applied before WER/CER scoring.

metrics.description: Metric ids this profile requires (see docs/specs/metrics.md).

overridable.description: Bounded, reviewed set of model/configuration keys a run may override via `goesb run --param KEY=VALUE` (ADR-0009). Every key must reference an existing key in this profile's own `model` or `configuration` block — that value is the default, not repeated here. Declaring, removing, or widening an entry is a profile version bump with a changelog entry, same review discipline as any other profile change.
